source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-28

procedures.title: Steering column: install
parts: turn signal, horn, back-up lamp and neutral start connectors
steps: Corvette: fasten the seal and support assembly to the dash panel from the engine compartment side (see figure 20 in the manual).
Corvette: tighten the clamp, washer and clamp bolt on the engine compartment side.
If the column has lower shift levers, connect the transmission linkage to them in the engine compartment and adjust per Section 7.
Refit the steering wheel as described in this section.
Plug in the turn signal, horn, back-up lamp and neutral start switch connectors; adjust the back-up lamp/neutral start switch per Section 12.
Adjust the steering gear and align and center the steering wheel as described in this section.

procedures.title: Steering column: realign
steps: Realign the column if there is slow return after turns, noise, an uneven feel when turning the wheel, or a distorted flexible coupling.
Also realign whenever the column has been fully loosened or taken out of the car.
Do the work with the car on the ground and all four wheels carrying its weight.
notes: The Corvette-specific procedure follows on the next page.
